segments.summary: Reviewed owner-map guards, runtime/file/storage seams, GUI/usage routing, rewrite architecture, provider auth carry-through, and promoted-shell authority; explicit boundaries are strong, while recovery, determinism, and auth-failure seam oracles are missing.

Reviewed PM planning boundaries, Instant Grep, browser confidence and stale cleanup, and slash/chat ownership; governance boundaries are explicit, while discoverability, consistency, confidence, and bounded-command semantics remain under-specified.

Reviewed HITL approvals, terminal ownership, file/editor remote behavior, worktree handoff, and Debug coupling; scope narrowing and packet gates are strong, while approval atomicity, remote recovery, and stale worktree transitions are unresolved.

Reviewed plan-map inventories, sparse-index routing, duplication hotspots, Context Lens, and rewrite guidance; consumer deference is explicit, but inventories lack dependency/precedence completeness and several known cross-doc drift seams remain active.

Reviewed shard governance, container/Unraid, Docker auth UX, runtime packets, blocked-state rendering, and feature-owner routing; generation boundaries and owner splits are clear, while operational security, runtime invariants, and GUI state-machine oracles are absent.

Reviewed visible source-control/Actions/Docker operations, retired aliases, Firecrawl owner and anchor maps, obligation routing, and slash/provider drift guards; anchor exactness is strong, but destructive UI actions, owner edges, closure state, and command input semantics need explicit contracts.

Reviewed Firecrawl reset scope, operation strength, legacy traceability, webmap guard, and A2A packet boundaries; supersession and process-artifact constraints are strong, while webmap behavior remains materially under-specified.

Reviewed A2A taxonomy and narrowing, evidence exactness, standardization ownership, and Native Goal Runtime routing; evidence and authority boundaries are clear, while taxonomy derivation, narrowing re-entry, and Goal Runtime provider/model transition seams lack executable oracles.
